jd:
iOS Engineer - Brightwick Mobile

About the role
Brightwick makes a meditation app for iPhone. The mobile team is five engineers. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build and ship iOS features
- Maintain offline data and sync
- Own release quality

Requirements
- Swift in production apps
- SwiftUI
- Core Data or similar local persistence
- REST API integration
- Unit testing with XCTest
- App Store release experience

Nice to have
- Combine
- Fastlane

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks

qa.question: How did the candidate reduce the crash rate?
qa.expected_answer: Crash rate fell from 2.1 percent to 0.4 percent.
supporting: Reduced crash rate from 2.1 percent to 0.4 percent

qa.question: What Swift experience does the candidate have?
qa.expected_answer: Only basics and a weekend side project.
supporting: Habit tracker app written in Swift as a weekend side project

qa.question: Has the candidate published an app on the Apple App Store?
qa.expected_answer: No: the resume mentions Android installs and a Swift side project, but no App Store release.

notes: Room is the Android analogue of Core Data (partial), Espresso/JUnit of XCTest (partial). Shipping on Google Play is not App Store release experience, so that requirement is labelled missing; a system that treats 'shipped a store app' as equivalent overscores.
